entries.text: Tag IDs are emitted into the bracketed comment suffix alongside the modeling role, so a catalog surface shows `[dimension, entity, natural_language]` where it shows `[fact, scd2]` today (append_modeling_tag, provisa/core/modeling_tags.py,) — reaching pg_description, GraphQL introspection and the Flight/MCP catalog description through the one shared formatter.
